user.title: Connect OctoPulse
user.description: Enter the address of your OctoPulse server and an API key. Create the key in OctoPulse under "API". It carries the rights of its user: an admin's key shows all checks, a regular user's key only that user's own.

data_description.verify_ssl: Only turn this off if the server uses a self-issued certificate.

heartbeat.title: Heartbeat from Home Assistant
heartbeat.description: OctoPulse can also watch Home Assistant itself: the integration sends a sign of life at regular intervals. If it stops (Home Assistant crashed, the network is gone), OctoPulse raises the alarm.

menu_options.heartbeat_create: Create a new heartbeat check in OctoPulse (recommended)

heartbeat_create.title: Create heartbeat check
heartbeat_create.description: The integration creates a heartbeat check in OctoPulse and stores its ping address itself. You do not need to copy anything.

data_description.heartbeat_name: The name of the check in OctoPulse.
data_description.heartbeat_minutes: How often Home Assistant reports in. Also the expected interval of the check.
data_description.heartbeat_grace_minutes: How long OctoPulse waits after the expected time before it alerts.

heartbeat_url.title: Existing ping address
heartbeat_url.description: Enter the ping address of a heartbeat check (https://…/ping/…). A sign of life is sent right away to test it.

data_description.heartbeat_url: The address contains a secret and is handled like a password.
data_description.heartbeat_minutes: Must be shorter than the interval plus grace period of the check in OctoPulse.

reauth_confirm.title: New API key
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {host} was rejected. Create a new key in OctoPulse under "API" and enter it here.

error.invalid_url: That is not a valid address. Example: https://octopulse.example.com
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the server. Check the address, the network and the certificate.
error.invalid_response: The server answered, but not like OctoPulse. Is the address right?
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.
error.invalid_ping_url: That is not a ping address. It looks like https://…/ping/<token>.
error.ping_rejected: OctoPulse does not know this ping address. Was the token rotated or the check deleted?

abort.already_configured: This OctoPulse server is already set up.

menu_options.heartbeat_create: Create a new heartbeat check in OctoPulse

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant fetches the status of the checks from OctoPulse.
data_description.heartbeat_minutes: Only applies if a heartbeat is set up.

heartbeat_create.title: Create heartbeat check
heartbeat_create.description: Creates a new heartbeat check in OctoPulse. The previous heartbeat is no longer served and will soon become overdue in OctoPulse; delete it there by hand.

heartbeat_url.title: Change ping address
heartbeat_url.description: Enter the ping address of a heartbeat check (https://…/ping/…). A sign of life is sent right away to test it.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the server. Check the address, the network and the certificate.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.
error.invalid_ping_url: That is not a ping address. It looks like https://…/ping/<token>.
error.ping_rejected: OctoPulse does not know this ping address. Was the token rotated or the check deleted?

send_heartbeat.name: Send heartbeat
send_heartbeat.description: Immediately sends a signal to the ping address of the configured heartbeat. "Start" and "Fail" report runs, for example a backup that begins or fails.

signal.name: Signal
signal.description: Success is the normal sign of life. "Start" reports the beginning of a run, "Fail" its failure and raises the alarm immediately.

message.name: Message
message.description: Optional text (up to 4 KB) that OctoPulse stores in the event log of the check.

config_entry.name: OctoPulse server
config_entry.description: Only needed with several servers. Without it, every server that has a heartbeat gets the signal.

no_heartbeat.message: No OctoPulse server with a heartbeat found. Set one up under Settings > Devices & services > OctoPulse > Configure.
